    58:     # depend on ufw and write an extra *nat block to '/etc/ufw/before.rules'.
    59:     # There is a problem though: iptables-restore (used by ufw) only creates or
    60:     # flushes user-defined chains. Built-in chains are not flushed. This works
    61:     # fine for our custom 'ansible-nat-output' chain, but the jump to that chain
    62:     # in 'OUTPUT' would be added again and again each time the firewall is

   493:     # missing host mount source (including an empty ~/.config/op), the full

     3: - name: Check if rtk binary already exists

     5:     path: /usr/local/bin/rtk

     8: # The stat gate is load-bearing: rtk_version is a static pin (see below),
     9: # not a live upstream query, so it carries no version-drift risk either way.
    10: # Without the gate, every converge would redundantly re-download and
    11: # re-extract the same pinned archive -- unarchive has no creates:-based
    12: # idempotency of its own.
    13: - name: Install rtk from a checksum-verified release archive
    14:   when: not rtk_stat.stat.exists
    15:   block:
    16:     # Only architectures listed in rtk_platform_map are supported.
    17:     - name: Verify supported processor architecture
    18:       ansible.builtin.assert:
    19:         that: "ansible_facts['architecture'] in rtk_platform_map"
    20:         fail_msg: >
    21:           Unsupported processor architecture: {{ ansible_facts['architecture'] }}.
    22:           Supported architectures are: {{ rtk_platform_map.keys() | list }}.
    23: 
    24:     # rtk_version is a static pin (roles/rtk/defaults/main.yml), refreshed only
    25:     # by playbooks/update-versions/perform-updates.yml -- see Constitution
    26:     # Principle II. checksum: is a literal instead of a live checksums.txt URL
    27:     # fetch so re-converge never silently re-verifies against a newer release.
    28:     - name: Download and checksum-verify the rtk release archive
    29:       ansible.builtin.get_url:
    30:         url: "https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/releases/download/{{ rtk_version }}/{{ rtk_platform_map[ansible_facts['architecture']] }}"
    31:         dest: "/tmp/{{ rtk_platform_map[ansible_facts['architecture']] }}"
    32:         checksum: "sha256:{{ (rtk_sha256_x86_64_musl if ansible_facts['architecture'] == 'x86_64' else rtk_sha256_aarch64_gnu) }}"
    33:         mode: '0644'
    34:

    36:       ansible.builtin.unarchive:
